confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Santiago price levels, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with season and neighborhood; July is Chilean winter, and the ski season may lift Andean-route demand. The FX observation (0.6955 as at 15 Oct 2026) comes from search-result summaries and was not confirmed by opening the RBA page directly. Cocktail and wine anchors use the local beer price as a reference, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-to-upper-tier Latin American capitals with similar tourist infrastructure, such as Buenos Aires, Montevideo, and Lima, adjusted to Santiago's generally higher restaurant and hotel prices relative to Lima and Bogota. Chilean peso-to-USD levels were used as the working reference.
